```{r}
# packages
library(tidyverse)
library(targets)
library(sf)
library(Distance)

library(INBOtheme)
theme_set(theme_inbo(transparent = TRUE))

# Conflicts
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Paths
mbag_dir <- rprojroot::find_root_file(criterion = rprojroot::is_git_root)
store <- file.path(mbag_dir,
                   "source", "targets", "distance_sampling", "_targets")

# Source functions
source(file.path(mbag_dir, "source", "R", "tar_read_ds.R"))
source(file.path(mbag_dir, "source", "R", "plot_detection_curve.R"))
source("summarise_detection_patterns.R")
```

```{r}
# To make it easier
params <- NULL
params$species <- "{{species}}"
#params$species <- "Veldleeuwerik"
```

```{r}
det_prob_df <- tar_read_ds("detection_probabilities", params$species , store = store) %>%
  select(-species) %>%
  replace(is.na(.), "-")

detprob_cap <- paste0("Geschatte detectiekansen ", params$species, ".")
```

De detectiekansen voor `r params$species` (*{{sci_name}}*) zijn weergegeven in @tbl-detprob-{{label}}.
`r summarise_detection_patterns(det_prob_df, params$species)`

```{r}
#| label: tbl-detprob-{{label}}
#| tbl-cap: "Geschatte detectiekansen {{species}}."
det_prob_df %>%
  mutate(detectiekans = paste0(
      sprintf("%.3f", round(estimate_p, 3)),
      " (",
      sprintf("%.3f", round(ll_beta, 3)),
      "-",
      sprintf("%.3f", round(ul_beta, 3)),
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select("jaar" = "year", any_of(c("regio", "openheid", "sbp")),
         "detectiekans (95 % interval)" = "detectiekans",
         "standaardfout" = "se_p") %>%
  kable(digits = 3)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
# Get densities
densities_stratum_target <- tar_read_ds("densities_stratum", params$species,
                                        store = store)
# Create plot
p <- densities_stratum_target %>%
  filter(
    year == 2023 & grepl("^Zandleem|^Leem", Label) | year != 2023
  ) %>%
  rename("stratum" = "Label", "estimate" = "Estimate") %>%
  filter(stratum != "Total") %>%
  separate(stratum, into = c("regio", "openheid", "sbp"), sep = " - ") %>%
  mutate(stratum = paste(openheid, sbp, sep = " - ")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = estimate, colour = stratum))

# Parse thresholds
threshold_vals <- tibble(
  species = c("Patrijs", "Geelgors", "Veldleeuwerik", "Grauwe Gors"),
  values = c(4, 12.5, 15, 10)
)
if (params$species %in% threshold_vals$species) {
  t <- subset(threshold_vals, species == params$species, "values", drop = TRUE)
  p <- p +
    geom_hline(yintercept = t, linetype = "dashed", colour = "darkgrey")
}

# Create final plot
p + geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lcl, ymax = ucl),
    width = 0.2,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(y = "broedparen / 100 ha", x = "", colour = "Stratum") +
  facet_wrap(~regio, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.8, 0.1),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"))
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
# Get densities
densities_region_target <- tar_read_ds("densities_region", params$species,
                                       store = store)

# Create plot
p <- densities_region_target %>%
  filter(
    year == 2023 & grepl("^Zandleem|^Leem", Label) | year != 2023
  ) %>%
  rename("region" = "Label", "estimate" = "Estimate") %>%
  filter(region != "Total") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = estimate))

# Parse thresholds
if (params$species %in% threshold_vals$species) {
  t <- subset(threshold_vals, species == params$species, "values", drop = TRUE)
  p <- p +
    geom_hline(yintercept = t, linetype = "dashed", colour = "darkgrey")
}

# Create final plot
p +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lcl, ymax = ucl),
    width = 0.1,
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(y = "broedparen / 100 ha", x = "") +
  facet_wrap(~region, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x")
```
